subject: Re: Kickoff: codistillation as our large-scale training recipe
body:
Hi Zofia,

Plan: Tereza Aliyev leads reproduction (50%), Kaia Wolde owns the baseline comparison harness (40%), Efe Lindqvist on data plumbing (30%). Saoirse Eriksen is committed at 65% to this project for May 2026 to build the two-worker prediction-exchange layer — that's the long pole, and May is when it has to land.

Compute: staying on titan-a100 best-effort, 64 GPUs steady state for the paired-replica runs. No reservation ask; if we get preempted the comparison is still fair since both arms run in the same pool.

One dependency: the paragraph-ID tarball decodes with the delta scheme from the release — Efe verified the sha256 — but restitching against the raw Common Crawl snapshot needs Corpus scratch space, roughly 30TB. I've filed the ticket with Jun's team.

Alina
